full_judgment: 8. Learned Advocates Mr AFM Mesbah-uddin Ahmed, Mr Subrata Saha and Mr Kamal Hossain appeared for the petitioner. Having placed the petition along with oral and documen-tary evidences the learned Advocates first of all submit that, the plaintiffs have denied title from the heirs of a son from their bia, who got title from daughters of Abdul Gafur (one sons of CS recorded owner Atorjan Bibi and from Saburun Nessa, daughter of Sabuja Bibi, one of the two daughters of the said CS recorded owner Atorjan Bibi). Their further contention is that no record of right could be produced in the name of Warish (one of sons of CS recorded owner Atorjan Bibi) as the case of the plaintiffs. Their further contention is that, although the name of their bia were rightly recorded in RS khatian No. 53, however, against RS plot No. 10, name of Md Fazor All and others as permitted by Abdul Malek has been wrongly recorded and that has created cloud in respect of title of the plaintiffs in the suit property, therefore, they have prayed for declaration of title in the suit property as well as the correction of wrong recording of name of Md Fazor Ali and others against RS plot No. 10 has been challenged other correction of the RS khatian No. 553, vide prayer Kha to the plaint. The learned Advocates submit that, the trial court has rightly discussed oral and documentary evidence on record and decreed the suit upon proper assessment of the case of the parties, but the appellate court, having failed to appreciate the case of the parties and assessing the evidence on record has passed the impugned judgment and decree and therefore, it has committed grave error of law causing serious prejudiced as regard the burden of proof. The learned Advocates has referred the decisions, reported in 54 DLR (AD) 26 between: Ishaque (Md) vs Ekramul Hague Chowdhury decision, reported in 1987 BLD (AD) 103 between: Chinibash Pramanik vs Nurul Hossain Mollah. They conclude that, this Rule has merit and the same may kindly be made absolute.
